title: Identification and Estimation of Forward-Looking Behavior: The Case of Consumer Stockpiling
eligible_reason: Dynamic structural model of consumer stockpiling with a step-function storage cost that point-identifies heterogeneous discount factors, estimated by MCMC (IJC algorithm) on IRI household panel data; promotion counterfactuals. No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: model estimation code/*/estimation_master*.r with ijc_Rcpp_par.cpp; make_tables.r and counterfactual_tables.r. The 59 lm() lines in the inventory are auxiliary regressions in test_functions.r (inclusive-value transitions), not reported DiD specifications.
data_files_note: Estimation data not shipped; data generation code builds it from the IRI Academic Dataset (Bronnenberg, Kruger and Mela 2008), obtainable by researchers.
data_provenance_note: IRI Academic Dataset must be obtained separately.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
